Subject: HealthIQ RFP: benchmarking pilots — request for cost-share and extension

Hi Olga / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the HealthIQ evaluation committee asked me to confirm whether Redwood would consider a cost-sharing arrangement for the upcoming benchmark. We have a fast-moving RFP (attached) comparing three vendors; procurement is asking for a 6-week pilot with side-by-side load and latency tests, plus an extended retention window for logs during the bake-off.

Two practical asks from our end:
- Can Redwood provide matching credit support for usage up to $35k, or a partial subsidy plus volume-based pricing for the pilot?
- Second, could you extend trial access from 14 to 28 days for this specific RFP so our infra team can run longer tail tests?

We need a short mutual action plan and any standard MOU you use for these engagements. Procurement prefers the offer documented in writing by the end of next week.

Attached: HealthIQ-RFP-Nov2026.pdf

Best,
Sarah Chen
Sr. Product Ops, HealthIQ

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: HealthIQ RFP: benchmarking pilots — request for cost-share and extension

Hi Sarah —

Really appreciate the context and the RFP doc. We can support a structured pilot that balances credit support and customer commitment. Rough proposal attached (see "Redwood-PilotCostShare-20261129.pdf"):

Summary of proposed terms
- Pilot length: 6 weeks (starts on provisioning)
- Credit support: Redwood will provide $25,000 in usage credits towards the pilot.
- Cost-share top-up: HealthIQ to cover overage beyond the credit pool at a negotiated pilot rate (50% off list for additional usage during pilot).
- Trial extension: we will extend the trial window to 28 days and allow audit-log retention for the duration of the pilot + 30 days after completion.
- Deliverables: mutual action plan (timeline + success metrics), sample prompt suite, and a short MOU (DocuSign).

Operational notes
- Dedicated endpoints are not required for the initial benchmark; we can provide a reserved short-burst pool if you want more consistent tail-latency signals.
- We’ll include per-route token and latency dashboards for the pilot to make comparison straightforward.

Next steps
1) If this looks acceptable, pls confirm procurement contact and preferred start week.
2) I’ll get a one-page MOU and the DocuSign link over to you for signature.

I’ve looped in Marcus and Ben for approvals and pricing confirmation, and Karthik to prep the MOU template.

Thanks,

— Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
